paragraphs.en: This repository contains the source code used to create the VM images for GitHub-hosted runners used for Actions, as well as for Microsoft-hosted agents used for Azure Pipelines. To build a VM machine from this repo's source, see the instructions .
paragraphs.zh: 本仓库包含用于创建 GitHub 托管的 Actions 运行器虚拟机镜像的源代码，也包含用于创建 Azure Pipelines 所使用的 Microsoft 托管的智能体的源代码。 要使用本仓库的源代码构建虚拟机，请参阅相关说明。

paragraphs.en: See notable upcoming changes by viewing issues with the Announcement label.
paragraphs.zh: 查看带有 Announcement 标签的议题（issue），了解即将发生的重要变更。

paragraphs.en: The purpose of a Beta is to collect feedback on an image before it is released to GA. The goal of a Beta is to identify and fix any potential issues that exist on that image. Images are updated on a weekly cadence. Any workflows that run on a beta image do not fall under the customer SLA in place for Actions. Customers choosing to use Beta images are encouraged to provide feedback in the runner-images repo by creating an issue. A Beta may take on different availability, i.e. public vs private.
paragraphs.zh: Beta 版的目的是在镜像正式发布（GA）之前收集反馈。 Beta 版的目标是识别并修复该镜像中存在的任何潜在问题。 镜像按每周的节奏进行更新。 在 beta 镜像上运行的任何工作流均不适用于 Actions 现有的客户 SLA。 鼓励选择使用 Beta 镜像的客户通过创建 issue 在 runner-images 仓库中提供反馈。 Beta 版可能具有不同的可用性形式，例如公开与私有。

sents.en: The purpose of a Beta is to collect feedback on an image before it is released to GA.
sents.zh: Beta 版的目的是在镜像正式发布（GA）之前收集反馈。

sents.en: The goal of a Beta is to identify and fix any potential issues that exist on that image.
sents.zh: Beta 版的目标是识别并修复该镜像中存在的任何潜在问题。

sents.en: Images are updated on a weekly cadence.
sents.zh: 镜像按每周的节奏进行更新。

sents.en: Any workflows that run on a beta image do not fall under the customer SLA in place for Actions.
sents.zh: 在 beta 镜像上运行的任何工作流均不适用于 Actions 现有的客户 SLA。

sents.en: Customers choosing to use Beta images are encouraged to provide feedback in the runner-images repo by creating an issue.
sents.zh: 鼓励选择使用 Beta 镜像的客户通过创建 issue 在 runner-images 仓库中提供反馈。

sents.en: A Beta may take on different availability, i.e. public vs private.
sents.zh: Beta 版可能具有不同的可用性形式，例如公开与私有。

paragraphs.en: This image type falls under the customer SLA for actions. GA images are eventually deprecated according to our guidelines as we only support the latest 2 versions of an OS.
paragraphs.zh: 此镜像类型属于面向操作的客户 SLA 范畴。 GA 镜像最终会根据我们的指导原则被弃用，因为我们只支持每个操作系统的最新 2 个版本。

paragraphs.en: GitHub Actions and Azure DevOps use the -latest YAML label (ex: ubuntu-latest , windows-latest , and macos-latest ). These labels point towards the newest stable OS version available.
paragraphs.zh: GitHub Actions 和 Azure DevOps 使用 -latest YAML 标签（例如 ubuntu-latest、windows-latest 和 macos-latest）。 这些标签指向当前可用的最新稳定版操作系统版本。

sents.en: GitHub Actions and Azure DevOps use the -latest YAML label (ex: ubuntu-latest , windows-latest , and macos-latest ).
sents.zh: GitHub Actions 和 Azure DevOps 使用 -latest YAML 标签（例如 ubuntu-latest、windows-latest 和 macos-latest）。

sents.en: These labels point towards the newest stable OS version available.
sents.zh: 这些标签指向当前可用的最新稳定版操作系统版本。

paragraphs.en: The -latest migration process is gradual and happens over 1-2 months in order to allow customers to adapt their workflows to the newest OS version. During this process, any workflow using the -latest label, may see changes in the OS version in their workflows or pipelines. To avoid unwanted migration, users can specify a specific OS version in the yaml file (ex: macos-14, windows-2022, ubuntu-22.04).
paragraphs.zh: -latest 迁移过程是渐进式的，将在 1-2 个月内完成，以便客户有时间为最新的操作系统版本调整其工作流。 在此过程中，任何使用 -latest 标签的工作流，其工作流或流水线中的操作系统版本都可能发生变化。 为避免不必要的迁移，用户可以在 yaml 文件中指定具体的操作系统版本（例如：macos-14、windows-2022、ubuntu-22.04）。

paragraphs.en: Upcoming changes: A pre-release is created when the deployment of an image has started. As soon as the deployment is finished, the pre-release is converted to a release. If you have subscribed to releases, you will get notified of pre-releases as well.
paragraphs.zh: 即将发生的变更：当镜像的部署开始时，会创建一个预发布版本。 部署一旦完成，该预发布版本就会转换为正式发布版本。 如果您订阅了发布版本，也会收到预发布版本的通知。

sents.en: Upcoming changes: A pre-release is created when the deployment of an image has started.
sents.zh: 即将发生的变更：当镜像的部署开始时，会创建一个预发布版本。

sents.en: As soon as the deployment is finished, the pre-release is converted to a release.
sents.zh: 部署一旦完成，该预发布版本就会转换为正式发布版本。

sents.en: If you have subscribed to releases, you will get notified of pre-releases as well.
sents.zh: 如果您订阅了发布版本，也会收到预发布版本的通知。

paragraphs.en: For high impact changes, we will post these in advance to the GitHub Changelog on our blog and on X .
paragraphs.zh: 对于影响重大的变更，我们会提前发布在博客的 GitHub 更新日志（GitHub Changelog）以及 X 上。

paragraphs.en: Tools and versions will typically be removed 6 months after they are deprecated or have reached end-of-life
paragraphs.zh: 工具及版本通常会在被弃用或生命周期结束后 6 个月内移除

paragraphs.en: We support (at maximum) 2 GA images and 1 beta image at a time. We begin the deprecation process of the oldest image label once the newest OS image label has been released to GA.
paragraphs.zh: 我们最多同时支持 2 个 GA 镜像和 1 个 beta 镜像。 一旦最新的操作系统镜像标签发布为 GA 版本，我们就会开始弃用最旧的镜像标签。

paragraphs.zh: 这些镜像通常包含已安装软件包的最新版本，但对于 Ubuntu LTS，我们主要依赖 Canonical 提供的软件源。

paragraphs.en: We do not plan to offer other Linux distributions. We recommend using Docker if you'd like to build using other distributions with the hosted runner images. Alternatively, you can leverage self-hosted runners and fully customize your VM image to your needs.
paragraphs.zh: 我们不计划提供其他 Linux 发行版。 如果您想使用其他发行版并通过托管的运行器镜像进行构建，我们建议使用 Docker。 或者，您也可以利用自托管的智能体，并根据需要完全自定义您的 VM 镜像。

paragraphs.en: macOS source lives in this repository and is available for everyone. However, macOS image-generation CI doesn't support external contributions yet so we are not able to accept pull-requests for now.
